groups.label: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.
groups.printed: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.

choices.name: Epitome of Piety
choices.text: A model with this Warlord trait gains the Priest (1) special rule. If the unit already has the Priest (x) special rule, increase the value of x by 1.

choices.name: Master of Arms
choices.text: A model with this Warlord trait gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) and Attacks (A) characteristics. In addition, they gain the Martial Feats special rule.

choices.name: Oathkeeper
choices.text: A model with this Warlord trait gains the Last Stand and Feel No Pain (6+) special rules.

groups.label: All Black Templars Priests with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following Prayers:
groups.printed: All Black Templars Priests with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following Prayers:
groups.name: Litanies of Faith

choices.name: Litany of Focus
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit has the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Fury
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gains the Fleet special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Hatred
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Resolve
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Feel No Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Rage
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Fear (1) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Strength
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.
